title: PromiseGuard Enterprise Delivery ETA Experience & Customer Satisfaction Survey
ethical_disclaimer: This survey evaluates customer experience benchmarks for on-demand logistics platforms. No personally identifiable information (such as names, phone numbers, or residential addresses) is collected or retained.

questions.text: Have you placed an online food-delivery order in the last 30 days?
Which platform did you use for your most recent order?
Approximately what time of day was your order placed?
What delivery-time estimate or range do you remember seeing upon ordering?
Approximately when did the order arrive relative to that stated estimate?
Did the delivery app proactively notify you when the order was delayed?
options: Only updated when I checked support/chat
Not applicable / Order was on time

questions.text: How satisfied were you with the overall delivery experience?
If you experienced dissatisfaction, what was the primary contributing factor?
How important is an accurate delivery-time estimate (ETA) to your ordering decision?
Would you prefer a realistic delivery time range (e.g. 35–45 min) over an overly optimistic single number (e.g. 30 min) that gets missed?
